domain.description: The host name the server asked about.

available.description: false when the server could not fetch the list. Then only reason and retry_after_seconds follow. It is true for a host without a certificate too.

reason.description: Present only when available is false. It is quota_exhausted: the server reached its request limit for the source.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before the server sends that request again. Present only when available is false.

complete.description: true when the walk read every page. false when the page cap stopped it. A certificate on an unread page is then left out, a newer one too.

certificate_count.description: It counts the certificates read, over all the pages read.

sha256_fingerprint.description: It is lower-case hex. For a precertificate it does not match the fingerprint of ssl_check.

issuer.description: The issuer name Cert Spotter gives. null when it gives none that fits.

issuer_caa_domains.description: The domains a CAA record can name to allow the issuer. null when the list is unknown.

valid_from.description: It is a UTC time, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

valid_until.description: It is a UTC time, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

revoked.description: null when Cert Spotter does not know.

dns_names.description: It lists the first 20 DNS names.

dns_name_count.description: It counts every DNS name, past the first 20 too.

certificates.description: At most 10 of the certificates read, those whose validity starts last, the latest first.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
